description: Companion to slo-reading/valid-envelope.json. The x402 consumer vector: a presidio-hardened/slo-reading@1 Layer-0 degradation reading (key-less, emitted by `pat evidence-emit`; degraded means value > threshold) signed into an evidence-ref@1 envelope by the bridge sidecar. item_id SLO-DEGRADED and ledger_ref match arch-translucency build_slo_evidence; presidio-hardened-x402's SLO payment broker verifies this envelope fail-closed (wrong key or tamper => reject, do not pay) before purchasing capacity.
